title: Smiling Father with Young Boy and Girl, 1940s B&W Family Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-20th-century outdoor family snapshot showing a smiling young man ('Bud') posing behind two seated children ('Kent' and 'Lynn') on a rocky, sunny ground. The young boy wears striped shirt overalls and an adult-sized fedora, while the young girl sits in a light-colored dress and dark beret, smiling coyly. Handwritten captions across the front borders read 'Bud & Kent and...' along the top edge and 'flatering Lynn' along the bottom. The reverse features an inverted stamp '32' in the upper corner.
